notes.title: Elves of Duty Demo Livestream
notes.content:
Elves of Duty is back for the final livestream of Steam Next Fest!

Download the free demo and let us know what you think of the game in the chat!

Have a crazy idea for a new power-up or level? Come share it with the community and help make Elves of Duty even better!
